persona: Non-native English speaker: literal wording only

conditions.browser: Isolated real Playwright Chrome browser session

steps.result: Redirected to https://base.tube/ai-thumbnails; landing explains thumbnails and has trial CTA.
Reached trial signup with Creator plan intent, form and card-charge note.

steps.action: Read signup literally, then stop at account-creation gate
steps.result: No account details entered, no agreement accepted, no checkout or generation.

blockers: Actual new-account registration and card-backed checkout were not completed. This is an unverified journey gate, not proof that signup is broken.

issues.title: Signup announces a future card charge without stating the price or billing period
issues.exactText: Next: secure checkout for your 7-day free trial of Creator, 2 videos included. Your card is charged on day 8 unless you cancel.
repro: Open /ai-thumbnails as a fresh visitor; browser redirects to base.tube/ai-thumbnails.
Click the hero “Start 7-day free trial” link.
Read the trial note before entering account details. No dollar amount or monthly/yearly cadence is visible on this screen.
issues.impact: A literal reader knows a charge will occur but cannot know how much or how often without leaving signup.

issues.title: The trial allowance is expressed as “2 videos” on a thumbnail product signup
issues.exactText: 7-day free trial of Creator, 2 videos included
repro: Read landing promise “Get three thumbnail ideas built from your video”.
Read the allowance “2 videos included” on signup; the page does not say this means sets of thumbnail actions, rather than generated videos.
issues.impact: For this non-native persona, “video” names the output rather than the billing unit. They cannot tell how many thumbnail images/edits the trial covers from this screen.

issues.title: Signup offers no direct pricing, terms or privacy links for a literal reader to resolve questions
issues.exactText: Back to AI Thumbnails / Continue / Secured by Clerk
repro: Follow the free-trial CTA to signup.
Inspect the full visible page, including the card footer.
The only product navigation is “Back to AI Thumbnails” and “Sign in”; no Pricing, Terms or Privacy links are present.
issues.impact: A reader with a price or data-use question must abandon the form and work out where to look; Clerk is named, but its role is not explained in ordinary words.

technicalNotes: Background console 401 errors accumulated on logged-out signup; no visible error toast was observed. Not counted as a persona-visible error.
Browser CLI overhead is not reported as product load time.
